Actual result: No access to real networks. Emulated Slow 3G (400 kbps, 400 ms) was used (NFT-06a).

Actual result: INP needs real-user data; lab Total Blocking Time (30-160 ms) is only a proxy.

Actual result: Single sandbox machine shares CPU with the load generator; 1,000 connections already produces client timeouts. Not demonstrated.
